d: Mokama ke vidhayak Anant Singh ki beti Shivangi ki shadi 25 navanbar ko Patna ke Nadwan ganv men huee, lekin yah samaroh sirph ek parivarik shadi tak simit nahin raha. mehmanon ki bhari bhir, bhavy pandal, saikron tarah ke pakvan, VIP mehmanon ke lie helipaid aur ghurdaur jaisi taiyariyon ne ise deshbhar ki surkhiyon men la diya. alag-alag midiya riports men mehmanon ki sankhya 2 lakh se lekar 5 lakh tak bataee gaee.
